The '''1986–87 Cypriot First Division''' was the 48th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league. [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] won their 15th title.

==Format==
Sixteen teams participated in the 1986–87 Cypriot First Division. All teams played against each other twice, once at their home and once away. The team with the most points at the end of the season crowned champions. The last two teams were relegated to the [[1987–88 Cypriot Second Division]].

The champions ensured their participation in the [[1987–88 European Cup]] and the runners-up in the [[1987–88 UEFA Cup]].

==Changes from previous season==
No team was relegated from the previous season. The first two teams of the [[1985–86 Cypriot Second Division]], [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos Achna]] and [[Omonia Aradippou]] were promoted and added to the First Division.

|note_APN=In 1986 [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] was drawn against [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Besiktas J.K.]] for the second round of the [[1986–87 European Cup]]. This was the first time that a Cypriot team faced a Turkish team in a European football competition (see [[Cyprus dispute]]). The Cypriot government prohibited APOEL from playing against the Turkish team, so APOEL was punished with one year disqualification from any UEFA competition. So, the third team of the table, [[EPA Larnaca FC|EPA]], took APOEL place in [[1987–88 UEFA Cup]].
